verdict.rationale: AWS provides extensive official SDK support for AI-native development, including Bedrock AgentCore explicitly supporting LangChain, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, Strands SDK, and custom frameworks, plus CDK SDKs across TypeScript, Python, Java, C#, Go for infra-as-code, and official CLI tooling. This directly targets AI-native/agentic builders with production-grade SDKs and deployment paths across any model/framework. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer corroboration of SDK quality/agent framework integration beyond AWS's own docs.
